_comment_top: NimRTC vendor manifest. Locks every third-party dependency to a specific commit/tag/SHA so reproducible builds are possible without 280+ MB of vendored source. See docs/plan/vendor-migration.md.

policy._comment_policy: Submodules with pinned SHAs are the source of truth. This file is read by tools/check_vendor.py to verify local submodules match. Update by running `python tools/vendor_update.py <name>`.

vendors.name: wolfssl
vendors.notes: DTLS production backend. Submodule path is /src because CMakeLists.txt add_subdirectory(src wolfssl_build) is the layout wolfSSL ships.

vendors.name: webrtc_audio_processing
vendors.build: external (Meson) — see tools/build_webrtc_apm.{cmd,sh}; CMake only consumes pre-built artifacts under build_meson/
vendors.notes: WebRTC APM. Built out-of-tree via Meson (not CMake) because upstream is Meson-first. After clone, run tools/build_webrtc_apm.sh (Linux/macOS) or tools/build_webrtc_apm.cmd (Windows).

vendors.name: mbedtls
vendors.build: HISTORICAL ONLY — DTLS production path migrated to wolfSSL. CMake wrapper at src/third_party/mbedtls/CMakeLists.txt only exposes headers via INTERFACE.
vendors.notes: No longer linked into nimrtc_dtls. Retained as archival source per CHANGELOG.md [0.9.0-rc1] Deferred-for-1.0 note; full removal is its own PR.

vendors.name: googletest
vendors.notes: Test framework. Submodule root contains googletest/ and googlemock/ directories. v1.12.0 used because v1.12.1 was never tagged upstream.

vendors.name: nlohmann_json
vendors.build: Single-header INTERFACE library — only the header is needed.
vendors.notes: Single-header JSON. Submodule root has single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp; CMakeLists.txt wraps it as nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json.

tools.name: tools/check_vendor.py
tools._comment: Verifies every submodule SHA matches this manifest. Wired into CI as warning-only gate.

tools.name: tools/vendor_update.py
tools._comment: Pulls a new upstream tag, updates the submodule, and rewrites vendor.json.

tools.name: tools/ci_preflight.py
tools._comment: Cross-platform pre-flight check for CMake ≥ 3.25 and required build tools.
